newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jade Technologies placement shares fully taken up.
newsitem.headline: Jade Technologies placement shares fully taken up.

text.p: The placement shares set aside by Jade Technologies Singapore Ltd in its Singapore initial public offer has been fully taken up, lead manager and underwriter DBS Bank said on Wednesday.

"Six million shares are set aside for the general public, staff and business associates of the company. The remaining two million shares have been fully placed out to institutional investors," Kan Shik Lum, DBS Bank's senior vice president of investment banking told reporters.
Jade, a producer of leadframes for the semiconductor industry, offered eight million new shares at Singapore S$0.75 each to be listed on the second board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
Jade is a subsidiary of U.S. Industries Inc.
